cross_calibration.rule: For each fixed local cell and stress cell, AGREES iff both historical and local summaries are finite and their active/inactive classification agrees at the frozen tolerance; DIFFERS iff both are finite and it differs; INCOMPARABLE otherwise.

gate_families.contextual_historical_phenotype: all historical representation-specific, spatial, force, orientation, loading, and conditional-rank gates retain their original packet/control scope
gate_families.shared_observer: full-lattice perturbation-state norm under exactly the same formula on both families
gate_families.universal_sanity: finite native state summary, fixed zero-source identity control, and exact artifact integrity; these are not replacements for phenotype gates

smallest_neutral_shared_observer_vector.name: NATIVE_PERTURBATION_L2_FOUR_SUMMARY
smallest_neutral_shared_observer_vector.native_formula: s(t)=sqrt(sum_all_sites,sum_components(delta_u(t)^2 + delta_p(t)^2)); V=(s(0), s(180), min_t s(t), max_t s(t)) for t=0..180
smallest_neutral_shared_observer_vector.repository_local_delta: stored EMX038 neutral source-lift state relative to its declared zero background

stress_registry.ineligible_nonfull_region: No EMX038 region-resolved history was retained; no subregion bridge may be reconstructed or simulated.
